column1: # Unsafe variants of the shipping torrent stack.
# Read by both tests/compose_gate.rs (`cargo test`) and scripts/vpn-gate.sh
# (stage 1), so the assertions CI runs and the assertions the release gate runs
#   id        short name used in output
#   expected  substring that must appear in a rejection message
#   overrides comma separated compose files in tests/vpn-gate/unsafe/
#   env       space separated KEY=VALUE pairs exported for the render
# Every row must be REJECTED. A row that renders and validates cleanly is a gate
# failure, because it means a known-unsafe layout passed.
# The live stages of scripts/vpn-gate.sh add the cases that need real containers
# (DNS leak through a hand-written resolv.conf, a broken kill switch, a stopped
# tunnel); those are listed in scripts/vpn-gate.sh and cannot be expressed here.
